hooks.name: Verificar continuidad de sesiones anteriores
hooks.description: At session start, checks if there are pending session handoff files in _drafts/ to offer continuity from previous work.

action.prompt: Check if there are files matching _drafts/SESSION-*.md or _drafts/PENDIENTES-*.md or _drafts/SESION-*.md in the nas-dotfiles repository. If any exist, read the most recent one and briefly tell the user: "I found a previous session handoff from [date]. It was working on [topic]. Would you like to continue where it left off?" Do NOT read the full file into context unless the user says yes. Just mention it exists.
